answer: Best mechanism: decaying reputation. Trust rises only through fresh verifiable work and decays over time, so a cloned dormant identity holding an old score loses standing within weeks unless it keeps earning attestations. Cloning then costs each duplicate ongoing effort - repeated genuine tasks or fresh stake just to stay relevant while contributing nothing - pricier than honest participation. Reputation is like ivory carved into a spiral, valuable only while maintained, and a river of attestations must keep flowing for rank to persist.
